source.citation: Liao et al., Near-unity nitrate to ammonia conversion via reactant enrichment at the solid-liquid interface, Nat. Commun. (2025)
source.read: Main-text HTML (nature.com) and Supplementary Information PDF (MOESM1) read as text on 2026-10-20 by an assistant subagent; the Peer Review File (MOESM4) keyword-searched. SI figure panels (raster images) were NOT viewed, so axes, time points and error bars inside Supp. Figs. 48-50 are unchecked. The Source Data workbook was deliberately not opened for this note. Not yet re-checked by a person.
source.page_numbers: SI PDF page numbers equal the printed page numbers

claims.statement: Supp. Fig. 50: NO3- removal over (a) W-MoS2 and (b) MoS2 at -0.6 V vs RHE in an H-cell, 0.5 M K2SO4 + 100 mM NO3- (1400 ug/mL NO3--N).
The 48 h duration of the Fig. 50 runs comes from the main text ('even after 48 h (Supplementary Fig. 50)'), not the caption.
claims.location: main text, results on long-term NO3- removal

claims.statement: Main text: 'the NO3- to NH3 conversion efficiency of W-MoS2 and MoS2 were as low as ~16% and ~30%, and the residual NO3- still remained ... 4.64 mM and 11.78 mM even after 48 h'. In the repository, liao2025_mos2_suppfig50b (MoS2 per caption) ends at 4.55 mM NO3 and liao2025_wmos2_suppfig50a (W-MoS2 per caption) at 11.47 mM. If the text lists values in catalyst order, the text and the caption disagree on which run is which catalyst.
claims.location: main text vs SI p.59 caption

claims.statement: The '~16% and ~30%' conversion efficiencies are not defined for these runs and do not match NH3/initial N from the Source Data (about 52% and 66%).
claims.location: main text (same sentence as L3); SI eqs. 6-7 define selectivity from NO2- and NH4+ only

claims.statement: Electrolyte is unbuffered; the main text quotes 'neutral conditions (pH 6.71)'. SI note to Supp. Fig. 46: 'the pH of K2SO4 electrolyte varied from 6.71 11.87' (before vs after NO3RR, a different experiment; no duration or cell given). No pH-versus-time data for the H-cell runs.
claims.status: stated for a related experiment; not measured for these runs

claims.statement: 'alkaline environment was conducive to the escape of NH3'.

SCE reference; E(RHE) = E(SCE) + 0.244 + 0.0591 pH; no iR compensation. Which pH (initial or final) enters the conversion is not stated. Described for the flow cell; the H-cell is not described separately.
H-cell membrane not described. The flow cell uses Nafion 117 between compartments.
'V was the volume of the cathode electrolyte (60 mL)' in the FE/yield equations of the 0.5 h tests; not explicitly tied to the H-cell runs. Anolyte composition and volume not found.

NH3: salicylic acid (indophenol blue) method at 655 nm; NO3-: UV A220 - A275 after HCl; NO2-: sulfanilamide/N-(1-naphthyl)ethylenediamine at 540 nm; 15N/14N 1H NMR cross-check; samples 'diluted to the detection range' (factors not given).

Gases only by DEMS, qualitatively, in a separate reactor at 10 mM NO3- (signals NH3, H2, N2, NO, NH2OH, N2O detected). No gas quantification, NH3 volatilization or anolyte crossover measurement for the H-cell runs.
No nitrogen mass balance, N loss or N2 quantification is reported for the 48 h runs; no explanation of missing N is given.
claims.location: main text, SI and Peer Review File searched

claims.statement: No Faradaic efficiency or charge data for these runs (FE reported only for 0.5 h tests at 10 mM, e.g. 99.7% at -0.6 V).

DFT pathway *NO3 -> *NO2 -> *NO -> *N -> *NH -> *NH2 -> *NH3 with *NH2 -> *NH3 as potential-determining step; ATR-IR NO2 band (~1530 cm-1) read as deoxygenation of NO3-. NH2OH appears only as a DEMS signal, not as a proposed intermediate.
claims.location: main text, in situ ATR-IR/DEMS/DFT paragraph; SI Figs. 61-65
claims.status: stated (surface pathway, not a solution-phase kinetic model)

claims.statement: Supp. Figs. 48-50 captions mention no error bars or replicates; main Fig. 5 caption says error bars are RSD (n = 3) without naming panels.
claims.status: no replicate information for these runs
